about_the_game:
Step into the role of a technomaster in Valkyrie Iteration, a gripping sci-fi visual novel. Train and guide Lana, a young pilot, and her sentient mech, the Valkyrie, as they prepare for high-stakes battles against otherworldly foes.

Balance intense combat training, mech maintenance, and Lana’s fragile mental state to ensure victory. Forge a bond with Lana, but beware: the Valkyrie’s power threatens to consume her very essence. Your choices shape her fate in this emotional, strategic journey through a war-torn future.

  • Plan Lana’s daily schedule: Choose actions for the day and evening, such as training, resting, or talking, to influence her skills, mental health, and bond with the Valkyrie.

  • Make strategic decisions: Balance synchronization and strength with fatigue and depression to prepare Lana for critical missions.

  • Explore Lana’s story and the world around her with every new iteration.

  • Multiple endings, each revealing a different facet of the truth.

Background

In a distant future, humanity is under siege by mysterious beings known as Phantoms. These entities defy the laws of nature and seem to come from another dimension, tearing at the very fabric of reality itself. They appear as shifting, intangible shapes that cannot be fought by any conventional means.

To counter this threat, humanity created the Valkyries — massive combat mechs, each with a soul of its own. These living machines are more than mere weapons; they have their own instincts and personalities, and they only accept pilots who can connect with them on a deep, emotional level.

In this endless war, the Valkyries and their chosen pilots stand as humanity’s last defense against the endless tide of Phantoms, fighting not just with steel, but with spirit.

---

Valkyrie Iteration is a visual novel where players plan Lana’s daily routine, choosing actions like training or rest to manage her skills and mental health. Monitor her synchronization with the Valkyrie mech while balancing fatigue and depression. Features branching dialogue, pixel art portraits, and multiple endings with auto save/load for replayability.
